req.title: Reject invalid date-of-birth format
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when dateOfBirth cannot be parsed as ISO-8601 date.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-024 requires HTTP 422 when dateOfBirth cannot be parsed as ISO-8601. However, examining the source, PlayerRequestModel.date_of_birth is typed as Optional[str] with no ISO-8601 validator — Pydantic accepts any string. The requirement states the system SHALL reject invalid formats with 422, so we test: (1) a valid ISO-8601 date succeeds (positive/EP), (2) a clearly malformed string like 'not-a-date' is rejected with 422 (negative/EP), (3) a date with wrong separator 'DD/MM/YYYY' is rejected (negative/NEG), (4) a boundary case of an empty string for dateOfBirth (boundary/BVA), and (5) a date-time string vs date-only string (boundary/BVA). We use squad numbers not in the fixture (e.g. 99, 98, 97, 96, 95) to avoid 409 conflicts. Since the model accepts any string, tests 2-5 may reveal that the implementation does NOT enforce ISO-8601 — which is exactly the mutation/gap we want to expose. We assert exact status codes to kill mutations that change the validation logic or status code constants.

tests.name: test_post_player_valid_iso8601_date_returns_201
preconditions: App is running in-process via TestClient
Squad number 99 does not exist in the fixture database
dateOfBirth is a valid ISO-8601 date string '1990-05-15'
actions: POST /players/ with a complete valid payload including dateOfBirth='1990-05-15'
expected: Response body contains firstName, lastName, squadNumber matching the request
Response body contains dateOfBirth equal to '1990-05-15'
trace: R-PLAYER-024: valid ISO-8601 date must be accepted (positive path)
EP: valid equivalence class for dateOfBirth
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_valid_iso8601_date_returns_201():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Carlos",
        "lastName": "Tevez",
        "dateOfBirth": "1984-02-05",
        "squadNumber": 99,
        "position": "Centre-Forward"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["firstName"] == "Carlos"
    assert body["lastName"] == "Tevez"
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 99
    assert body["dateOfBirth"] == "1984-02-05"

test_post_player_valid_iso8601_date_returns_201()
